title: SREV-023 PipeServer thread liveness cleanup

process_id_of_thread_shape.description: GetProcessIdOfThread returns the process identifier for a thread handle

thread_object_lifecycle.description: Thread object state becomes signaled when the thread terminates; thread object is not freed until all open handles are closed

wait_zero_shape.description: WaitForSingleObject with timeout 0 checks state and returns immediately; SYNCHRONIZE access right is required to wait on a thread handle

legacy_path_topology.description: Vista LPC PortDisconnectByCreateTime receives port-closed with no CID and only a process creation timestamp; finds matching process and scans stored client threads

liveness_gate.description: OpenThread(THREAD_QUERY_INFORMATION | SYNCHRONIZE) -> GetProcessIdOfThread match -> WaitForSingleObject(hThread, 0) == WAIT_TIMEOUT; only then keep the client thread

stale_routing.description: Signaled thread, failed wait, missing thread, or process-id mismatch routes to existing PortDisconnectHelper cleanup

runtime_matrix.description: Windows runtime gate: thread entry removed after client thread exits; still-running thread retained; process-level cleanup fires when last thread removed; normal broker requests unaffected

contracts: Successful OpenThread alone does not prove the thread is still running
Liveness requires WAIT_TIMEOUT from WaitForSingleObject with zero timeout
OpenThread must request SYNCHRONIZE in addition to THREAD_QUERY_INFORMATION
Process-id mismatch is treated as stale
